It does not suit people who fear boredom, cannot tolerate night shifts, or panic during emergencies. Guards alternate long seated periods with patrols and rotating shifts.
A common path is direct job training, gate or patrol duty, obtaining a security guard license, becoming a core guard, then advancing to team leader, security supervisor, or project manager.
